name: App builder — idea to production-ready app
description: Turns an idea into a release candidate under a deterministic projects/<slug>-<id>/ path. Product discovery and technical planning run first, then a human approval gate confirms the exact plan and destination before any code is written. Backend, frontend, and devops/security build with shell access; a real zero-exit test gate must pass before three execute-only reviewers assess security, operability, and UX. Failed tests or readiness findings loop through an on-call fix step. Reports stay inside the generated project, and every fallible step has an explicit failure path.

nodes.text:
slug = ''.join(c if c.isalnum() else '-' for c in value.lower())
while '--' in slug: slug = slug.replace('--', '-')
slug = slug.strip('-') or 'app'
checksum = sum((i + 1) * ord(c) for i, c in enumerate(value)) % 100000000
print(f"projects/{slug[:48]}-{checksum:08d}")
